Trump Defends AI Data Centers as Backlash Grows
In a
Truth Social
post, Trump argued that communities opposing data centers risk becoming backward and poor, saying those that embrace the facilities could benefit from jobs, investment and lower taxes.
"If they want to be successful and rich, with far lower taxes and jobs all over the place, let Data Reign," Trump wrote. He also warned that blocking projects could benefit China.
"If we kill the Golden Goose, you will only have yourselves to blame," Trump said, adding that China "could not be happier" about the growing anti-data-center movement.
